observations.title: Load camera film
observations.player_action: Insert a film roll into a camera via the sneak-use attachments UI, then enter the viewfinder.
observations.outcome: Camera can expose frames rather than merely taking screenshots.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Собери камеру и вставь в неё фотоплёнку.

observations.title: Compose and expose a photograph
observations.player_action: While in the viewfinder, use camera controls for shutter speed, composition guides and installed flash.
observations.outcome: Capture a film frame with chosen settings.

observations.title: Develop and print film
observations.player_action: Use the film-developing process and Lightroom to print photographs from film negatives.
observations.outcome: Physical photograph items available for display and albums.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Прояви плёнку и напечатай первую фотографию.

observations.review_note: A mere photograph item is not proof the player personally exposed and developed a frame.

observations.title: Archive photographs in an album
observations.player_action: Place printed photographs into a Photo Album; optionally sign the album to prevent editing.

quest_seed.goal_ru: Собери альбом из нескольких собственных фотографий.

observations.title: Automate Lightroom printing
observations.player_action: Give the Lightroom a redstone pulse to start printing the selected frame and advance the film.
observations.outcome: Potential Create/redstone factory challenge; requires source-level integration verification.

observations.title: Exposure and Exordium viewfinder issue
observations.player_action: If Exordium is installed, investigate official author warning about viewfinder flicker.
observations.outcome: Compatibility watch, not proof of a current JEM defect.
observations.review_note: Manifest snapshot does not include Exordium; never report this as an active conflict.

observations.title: Exposure and Visual Overhaul camera controls
observations.player_action: If Visual Overhaul is installed, investigate official author warning about camera controls crash.
observations.outcome: Compatibility watch, not proof of a current JEM defect.
observations.review_note: Manifest snapshot does not include Visual Overhaul; validate exact versions before reporting.
